annotations.title: Create a custom or lookalike audience

description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Creates a Meta custom audience on the brand's selected ad account from a preset: site_visitors (the brand's Meta pixel visitors), signup_page_visitors (pixel visits to the sign-up page; urlContains overrides the configured path), trial_starters (people who fired the trial event), customer_list (empty; fill it with ads_audience_users_add) or lookalike (seedAudienceId from ads_audiences_list, country, ratio). retentionDays sets the website window. Website presets need the brand's Meta pixel (409 ADS_NO_META_PIXEL). Which presets are on and the ranges are the owner's ads config (403 AUDIENCE_PRESET_DISABLED). An audience never spends. Pass agentName and reason. Audited in Ads > Agent activity. Guardrails: flayr enforces the owner's agent ceiling (per month, per campaign, per day) on the server; you cannot raise it. Inside it the change is applied at once; above it nothing changes and the result is `approval_requested` (HTTP 202) with `approvalId` and `approvalUrl`, the owner's one-click approval link: give it to the user (an owner can also decide approvalId with approvals_decide, through a different connection). When the owner set approvals to API/MCP/chat only (`assistantOnly: true`) there is no link: tell the user to approve approvalId with approvals_decide or in flayr chat. Either way, repeat the exact same call once the owner approves (the approval covers that call once). Every call is audited (Ads > Agent activity) and the owner gets a daily digest. Pass agentName and reason; both are shown to the owner.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/audiences.)

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

name.description: Up to 100 characters; default: the preset name.

ratio.description: lookalike only: the share of the country's people, inside the configured range (default the minimum, 0.01 = 1%).

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

retentionDays.description: Website presets: how many days back the audience reaches (1 to the configured max, Meta max 180).

seedAudienceId.description: lookalike only, required: a flayr audience id in this brand (not a lookalike).

urlContains.description: signup_page_visitors only: the URL part that marks the sign-up page; default from the ads config.

name: ads_audience_create
title: Create a custom or lookalike audience
